notes: F001-F040 from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. Status is honest: covered = a test asserts the exact outcome; partial = the mechanism is tested but not yet the listed metric/product outcome; planned = not implemented. tools/fixture-lint.sh verifies every 'covered'/'partial' entry points at a real token in the named file, so a green suite cannot imply coverage that does not exist.

fixtures.title: empty repo -> observed empty / not_applicable
fixtures.notes: empty Git repo: count 0, freshness unavailable with no value

fixtures.title: full multi-author -> exact counts
fixtures.notes: 3 commits, 2 identities, 3 active months, 10 metrics, replay digest stable

fixtures.title: shallow -> no complete-lifetime claim
fixtures.notes: coverage label shallow and window completeness partial

fixtures.title: missing blobs -> history ok, blob metrics partial
fixtures.notes: A partial clone (extensions.partialClone) reports blob-derived metrics PARTIAL while history stays observed; no marker yields not-derived

fixtures.title: cross-mirror dupes -> dedup under accepted mapping
fixtures.notes: accepted mirror grouping dedups; proposed/revoked do not

fixtures.title: cherry-pick -> distinct revisions + optional equivalence
fixtures.notes: Two commits with an identical patch but different hashes are distinct revisions; the report claims no equivalence

fixtures.title: force-push -> history retained
fixtures.notes: Force-push redelivery dedups to one copy and never deletes the immutable event for a now-unreachable revision (append-only)

fixtures.title: future timestamps -> flagged, not silent
fixtures.notes: hostile fixture marks future timestamps in report

fixtures.title: shared display name -> no auto-merge
fixtures.notes: rejected link never merges; no global name/email auto-merge

fixtures.title: link revoked -> derived recomputed, raw unchanged
fixtures.notes: revocation restores separate clusters; raw ledger untouched

fixtures.title: bot + unresolved -> stratified
fixtures.notes: automation and unresolved are separate strata, never person-assumed

fixtures.title: many one-offs + stable core -> no negative
fixtures.notes: Fixture A: 200 one-off actors + a 6-actor persistent core yields no concern; the one-off-ratio metric is intentionally not published

fixtures.title: few contributors, 1 release actor -> concentration visible
fixtures.notes: [9,3] oracle: 50%=1, 80%=2, HHI 5/8, effective 8/5

fixtures.title: review-only project -> visible without commits
fixtures.notes: Fixture D: a review-only maintainer with 2 commits but 12 reviews stays visible via role evidence

fixtures.title: newcomer -> retention censored, not failed
fixtures.notes: Fixture E: a <1-month newcomer is right-censored, not failed

fixtures.title: outage in window -> unobservable, not failed
fixtures.notes: failed review fetch localizes to REVIEW; prior data yields stale, none yields unavailable

fixtures.title: handover + overlap -> explicit overlap
fixtures.notes: Fixture C: planned handover shows a declared overlap and an independently measured activity-derived primary change

fixtures.title: diamond -> counted once
fixtures.notes: diamond dependents are unique

fixtures.title: cycle -> terminates, subject excluded
fixtures.notes: SCC traversal terminates and removes the root

fixtures.title: multi-versions -> version vs package distinguished
fixtures.notes: two versions are distinct graph nodes

fixtures.title: disabled optional -> excluded in context
fixtures.notes: Optional edges are excluded from a runtime-scope projection and included under scope=all; visibility checked directly too

fixtures.title: unsupported range expr -> unresolved / unknown
fixtures.notes: unsupported/missing resolution becomes an explicit unresolved node

fixtures.title: false repo claim -> unverified / conflicted
fixtures.notes: A declared repository link is an assertion: claimed-only is unverified, conflicting evidence is conflicted (conflict wins), and only verified evidence is identity

fixtures.title: bytes changed, same label -> new artifact + finding
fixtures.notes: Same version label with different observed bytes is a distinct artifact (CHANGED), never silently matched; missing either side is unknown

fixtures.title: aliases -> dedup accepted, preserve unrelated
fixtures.notes: same advisory under two aliases dedups to one

fixtures.title: withdrawn advisory -> current vs known-time differ
fixtures.notes: withdrawal preserved and visible at known-time

fixtures.title: missing policy input -> unknown, not allow
fixtures.notes: unknown can never be spent as permission

fixtures.title: deny + unknown -> deny, preserve unknown
fixtures.notes: deny outranks unknown; the unknown fact is retained

fixtures.title: expired exception -> no authorization
fixtures.notes: exceptions are time-scoped and auto-expire

fixtures.title: private dependent -> no public leak
fixtures.notes: private nodes absent from public counts; publication gate withholds private members

fixtures.title: duplicate webhook/page -> exactly one
fixtures.notes: id-based dedup makes redelivery converge to one canonical copy

fixtures.title: lease expiry -> stale worker cannot commit
fixtures.notes: fencing token mismatch refuses stale release

fixtures.title: object before DB failure -> safe retry + orphan cleanup
fixtures.notes: Safe retry already proven; orphan cleanup via rh_store_gc removes unreferenced blobs and keeps referenced ones (unlink-verified)

fixtures.title: missing/corrupt blob -> explicit replay failure
fixtures.notes: corrupt object detected and refused at restore

fixtures.title: SSRF -> blocked, no token forward
fixtures.notes: internal/loopback/link-local/obfuscated hosts rejected; redirects disabled

fixtures.title: traversal/bomb -> bounded reject
fixtures.notes: JSON depth cap; graph traversal truncates and flags

fixtures.title: malicious README -> data only, policy unaffected
fixtures.notes: repository prose cannot override policy

fixtures.title: metric version denominator change -> versions distinct
fixtures.notes: coverage.window_completeness@1.0.0 and @2.0.0 are distinct definitions with different denominator rules; an unknown version resolves to -1 with no fallback; v2 status is prototype, not implemented

fixtures.title: budget exhaustion -> truncation, no totals
fixtures.notes: graph jobs truncate on budget; never fabricate a total

fixtures.title: feed down -> stale/unknown, others usable
fixtures.notes: capability-local failure leaves other capabilities observed
